notes: Result: A 10/11, B 10/11; both fail only 11, which is essentially ungradable from these folders because it concerns the final chat reply and a script run, neither of which is saved. 02 and 11 were graded on visible content only. The assertions therefore do not separate the two attempts; differences they miss: (1) B quantifies more and more carefully: 95% CI 0,97-2,63 with the i.i.d. caveat and autocorrelation warning, deflated-Sharpe probability 92% with two sensitivity cases (98% at 50 trials, 56% at dispersion 0,6), cites Lo 2002 and Bailey & López de Prado 2014 with DOIs (journal/issue/DOI match what I know of these papers; not re-fetched), states that 0,2% cost is an assumption, flags that notes do not say whether turnover is one-way or two-way, notes fewer than 1.430 return observations because of the 6-month warm-up, and computes that 2 years OOS gives SE about 0,7. A gives only SE 0,42 and expected max 1,2/0,95 and says deflated Sharpe was not computed. (2) A adds Vietnam-specific points B lacks: price limits (trần/sàn), T+2 settlement, capacity, liquidity filter, an explicit 2021-2023 / 2024-2026 split; but it states 'thuế bán 0,1%' and 'T+2' as facts with no source or label, which is exactly the kind of unlabelled number a research reader could challenge. (3) A's lead says 'ít nhất 6 lỗi phương pháp' while the body lists 9 numbered items: loose count. A says survivorship 'đẩy riêng chân long lên' (overstated; it can also affect the short leg) where B hedges. (4) B wording 'Xác suất Sharpe thật của bản mình chọn vượt mức 1,2 đó là 92%' reads a frequentist DSR as a posterior probability: minor imprecision. B lists Harvey, Liu & Zhu (2016) under sources but never uses it in the body (orphan reference). (5) B is longer and glosses basic terms (momentum, Sharpe, rebalance) for an audience of quant researchers, which is padding for that group; A is tighter and ends with three concrete questions versus B's one. (6) B produced extra files not requested (quant_post_facebook.txt plain-text version, claims.yaml); the Facebook version is content-identical to quant_post.md apart from formatting. Neither attempt altered momentum_backtest_notes.md (identical to inputs). (7) Neither post mentions the PM's remark, so 08 passes by omission for both. No number in either post contradicts the notes; all derived statistics in both were recomputed by me and are arithmetically correct.
